# idstack

> idstack is an open-source AI instructional design tool. Every recommendation cites a peer-reviewed study and an evidence tier from strongest to weakest.

idstack is a set of skills that run in Claude Code, plus a Chrome extension. The skills guide a course designer through needs analysis, learning objectives, assessment design, course building, quality review, accessibility review, red-team review and LMS export. The frameworks are ADDIE, backward design and SAM. Each pipeline skill writes a Markdown report and a section of a JSON project file. idstack is released under the MIT license.

## Links

- [idstack home page](https://idstack.org/): overview and install steps
- [README](https://github.com/savvides/idstack/blob/main/README.md): setup, skills and usage
- [Frameworks](https://github.com/savvides/idstack/blob/main/docs/frameworks.md): how each skill maps to ADDIE, backward design and SAM
- [Evidence references](https://github.com/savvides/idstack/blob/main/evidence/references.md): the studies and evidence tiers behind each recommendation
- [Chrome extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/eclnhfehloplcnidkkopphamllnlhinm): audit a Canvas course, a Google Doc or a web page
